name: kz-pgw-mcp
description: Staging backoffice API (+ read-only staging Postgres for devs) and PGW UAT verification for KZ.
long_description:
One MCP server for KZ payment-gateway work on staging.

- Role, asked once: **project** (backoffice login only, no DB) or **dev** (backoffice + read-only DB).
- `kz_*`: quick guide, set role.
- `bo_*`: login (TOTP), list funding methods, list a provider's orders, find test members, create deposit/withdraw, raw GET.
- `pg_*` (dev only): read-only SQL.
- Skills: kz-guide, kz-create-orders, kz-pgw-uat (UAT verdict per SOP OS-52).

Writes (deposit/withdraw) are off unless you enable them below.

tools.name: bo_login
tools.description: Login to a staging group backoffice (step 1)

tools.name: bo_check_access
tools.description: Can this staff login create deposits / withdraws? (DB read, dev role)

tools.name: bo_find_member
tools.description: Find test members by wallet balance (DB for dev, backoffice API for project)

tools.name: bo_list_methods
tools.description: List funding methods, resolve provider name → key

tools.name: bo_list_orders
tools.description: List a provider's deposit/withdraw orders in a time window

tools.name: bo_create_deposit
tools.description: Create a deposit order (needs writes enabled)

tools.name: bo_create_withdraw
tools.description: Create a withdraw order (needs writes enabled)

tools.name: pg_query
tools.description: Run one read-only SQL statement (dev role)

tools.name: pg_list_databases
tools.description: List databases on the staging cluster (dev role)

tools.name: pg_list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a schema (dev role)

tools.name: pg_describe_table
tools.description: Columns, indexes, FKs of a table (dev role)

role.title: Role: project or dev
role.description: project = PA / QA / PM, backoffice only (leave all DB / SSH fields empty). dev = backoffice + staging DB. Empty = asked in Claude on first use.

kz_username.title: Backoffice username
kz_username.description: Staff login. Same for all staging groups.

kz_password.title: Backoffice password
kz_password.description: Staff password for the staging backoffice.

allow_writes.title: Enable write tools
allow_writes.description: bo_create_deposit, bo_create_withdraw and non-GET bo_api. Creates real fundingTx on staging.

pg_host.title: Postgres host
pg_host.description: pgAdmin → kz-api-global → Properties → Connection → Host. Dev role only.

pg_user.title: Postgres user
pg_user.description: Postgres username (pgAdmin → Connection → Username). Dev role only.

ssh_host.title: SSH jump host
ssh_host.description: pgAdmin → SSH Tunnel tab. Leave empty for direct connect.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: SSH port of the jump host. Default 22.

ssh_user.title: SSH user
ssh_user.description: SSH username on the jump host.

ssh_password.title: SSH password
ssh_password.description: Leave empty to use ~/.ssh keys / ssh-agent instead.

vpn_gateway.title: NordLayer gateway
vpn_gateway.description: Named in the error message when the DB is unreachable.

skills_dir.title: Claude skills folder
skills_dir.description: Where bundled skills (kz-guide, kz-create-orders, kz-pgw-uat) are copied. Leave empty for ~/.claude/skills. Type off to skip.
